pages.title: Button
pages.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

pages.title: ButtonGroup
pages.description: A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.

pages.title: Toggle
pages.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

pages.title: ToggleGroup
pages.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

pages.title: Checkbox
pages.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

pages.title: Combobox
pages.description: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

pages.title: Field
pages.description: Combine labels, controls, and helper text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.

pages.title: Input
pages.description: A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.

pages.title: InputGroup
pages.description: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.

pages.title: InputOtp
pages.description: Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.

pages.title: Label
pages.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

pages.title: NativeSelect
pages.description: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.

pages.title: RadioGroup
pages.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

pages.title: Select
pages.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.

pages.title: Textarea
pages.description: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.description: A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.

pages.title: Accordion
pages.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

pages.title: Breadcrumb
pages.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

pages.title: Collapsible
pages.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

pages.title: Menubar
pages.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.

pages.title: NavigationMenu
pages.description: A collection of links for navigating websites.

pages.title: Pagination
pages.description: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

pages.title: Sidebar
pages.description: A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.

pages.title: Tabs
pages.description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.

pages.title: AlertDialog
pages.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

pages.title: Dialog
pages.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

pages.title: Drawer
pages.description: A panel that slides in from any edge of the screen to reveal supporting content.

pages.title: HoverCard
pages.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

pages.title: Popover
pages.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

pages.title: Sheet
pages.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

pages.title: Toast
pages.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

pages.title: Tooltip
pages.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

pages.title: Command
pages.description: Command menu for search and quick actions.

pages.title: ContextMenu
pages.description: Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.

pages.title: DropdownMenu
pages.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.

pages.title: Item
pages.description: A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.

pages.title: Slider
pages.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

pages.title: Switch
pages.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

pages.title: Avatar
pages.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

pages.title: Badge
pages.description: Same look of HeroUI's badge

pages.title: Chart
pages.description: Beautiful charts. Built using Recharts. Copy and paste into your apps.

pages.title: Empty
pages.description: Display an empty state with media, text, and actions.

pages.title: Kbd
pages.description: Used to display textual user input from the keyboard.

pages.title: Marker
pages.description: Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.

pages.title: Table
pages.description: A responsive table component.

pages.title: Alert
pages.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

pages.title: Progress
pages.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically as a progress bar.

pages.title: Skeleton
pages.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

pages.title: Spinner
pages.description: An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

pages.title: AspectRatio
pages.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

pages.title: Card
pages.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

pages.title: Carousel
pages.description: A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.

pages.title: Direction
pages.description: Sets the reading direction (LTR or RTL) for Base UI components inside it.

pages.title: Resizable
pages.description: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

pages.title: ScrollArea
pages.description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.

pages.title: Separator
pages.description: Visually or semantically separates content.

pages.title: Surface
pages.description: A simple container that applies surface background variants.

pages.title: Attachment
pages.description: Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload states, and actions.

pages.title: Bubble
pages.description: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.

pages.title: CodeBlock
pages.description: Displays code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers and a copy button.

pages.title: Message
pages.description: Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.

pages.title: MessageScroller
pages.description: A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.

pages.title: Questionnaire
pages.description: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.

pages.title: Trace
pages.description: Displays the steps an agent takes, such as reasoning, tool calls, and sources, as a list of rows.
